name: Shishiouin Hime
source:
The only heir to the Yuuki Corporation's one-time rival, the Shishiouin Corporation, Hime is a bit younger than the other girls, but skipped a grade and now attends class with them.
Proud, haughty, and self-important, she is the ultimate "ojou-sama."
She's known Toshiya since they were children, but they don't get along well and tend to end up fighting.

[from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/B81A75E1-C7A3-42FD-B091-89EDEBC9B51F/we-love-master]MangaGamer[/url]]
